corePassives.description: Ururu gains Spiritual Pressure Reserve when she uses basic attacks, Techniques, and counterattack, as well as when she triggers Perfect Dodge, up to 10 stacks. Spiritual Pressure Reserve can be used to launch special attacks.
corePassives.name: Ready to Fire

corePassives.description: Enemies within the Burning Area lose 50% Movement Speed and SPD. The effect ends 2s after they leave the Burning Area.
corePassives.name: Scorch

corePassives.description: When there is an enemy in the Burning Area, Ururu deals 30% more Spirit DMG.
corePassives.name: Suppressing Fire

name: Ururu Tsumugiya
note: No build guide available on hideoutgacha.com at time of authoring. Tier/role/damage type sourced from the tier list.

skills.description:
Ururu launches a melee attack at the target to strike 6 times, dealing damage equal to 322.5% of ATK. 
 Landing each basic attack restores 1 stack of Spiritual Pressure Reserve. ~~Target Sighted! Fire!~~ Press and hold basic attack with 1 or more stacks of Spiritual Pressure Reserve 
 Ururu enters the aimed firing state, during which each tap on the Basic Attack fires two cannonballs at the target, dealing up to 81% of ATK and Penetrating up to 2 targets, which halves the damage to subsequent targets. Each cannonball fired consumes 1 stack of Spiritual Pressure Reserve.
skills.name: Nice to Meet You

skills.description:
Ururu dashes forward and wields the cannon to knock back the enemy, dealing damage equal to 115.5% of ATK. Then, she leaps backward and fires a cannonball at the enemy, dealing damage equal to 172.5% of ATK. On hit or upon landing, the cannonball explodes and creates a 10s Burning Area. 
 If the technique hits the target, restores 5 stacks of Spiritual Pressure Reserve.
skills.name: Maintain Safe Distance

skills.description: Ururu fires a barrage of cannonballs at the enemy, dealing damage equal to 1530% of ATK. On hit, the cannonballs create a 10s Burning Area under the enemy's feet.
skills.name: Threat Neutralized!

skills.description:
Ururu knocks back the enemy with the cannon, dealing damage equal to 321% of ATK. Meanwhile, she also fires a cannonball at the enemy, dealing damage equal to 481.5% of ATK, launching the enemy into the air, and creating a Burning Area under the enemy's feet. 
 If the counterattack hits the target, restores 5 stacks of Spiritual Pressure Reserve.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Dodge to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5s. Cooldown: 15s. Perfect Dodges restores 5 stacks of Ururu's Spiritual Pressure Reserve.
skills.name: Dodge
